title: RailDS Asset Event Data
description: Common data contract for durable events associated with a RailDS asset. The CloudEvent type identifies this as an asset event; event.type identifies the specific kind of asset event. Event-specific fields are defined and validated separately.
$comment: This schema intentionally defines only fields common to asset events. It does not enumerate every allowed event.type and does not define event-specific payload fields. Examples of event types are non-exhaustive.

asset.description: The RailDS asset associated with the event.

id.description: Stable RailDS identifier for the asset.

eam_asset_id.description: Optional asset identifier from the owning agency's Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) system. This is distinct from the RailDS asset.id.

key.description: Human-manageable asset key when one is configured, for example 7-switch.

type.description: Machine-readable asset type, for example switch_machine, signal, or track_circuit.

event.description: Identity and version metadata for the configured or defined asset event. The outer CloudEvent id identifies the individual occurrence; event.id identifies the event definition/configuration that produced it.

id.description: Stable identifier for the configured or defined asset event, not the unique identifier of this individual occurrence.

type.description: Machine-readable event type used to select the event-specific definition. Examples are illustrative, not an exhaustive list.

definition_version.description: Version of the event-specific data definition used for this event type, for example switch-throw.v1.

logic_version.description: Version of event detection, correlation, or assembly logic, when the producer versions that logic.

configuration_revision.description: Revision of the producer configuration used to create the event, when configuration revisions are available.
